new_hazards_found.summary: a grouped reveal is graded all-or-nothing, so a card hiding N uncued answers fails at ~0.9^N even when every fact on it is known
the obvious fix for an overloaded list — renumbering it c1..cN on one note — makes N cards that each reveal the other N-1 answers
a chunked note states the FULL set's count while clozing only its own members, which trips R7's undercount warning and pushes the drafter into checker-shaped phrasing
an anchor note can cloze sub-group names the pipeline invented, which are in no source and cannot be produced cold
new_hazards_found.why: requires knowing whether a phrase is the source's vocabulary or ours; R13 grounding cannot see it because the sub-group NAME is a synthesis over text that is itself well grounded. Caught by editor check #25/#26 and the human review pass, and stated as a worked rule in card-rules #23.
